QuestInfo.name: [Azmoth Chasm] The Scouts' Story
QuestInfo.0:
Athena Pierce asks you to ask the scouting party about what they found in the chasm.

#r(* Must be started on the Azmoth Boundary map.)#k
QuestInfo.1: The three adventurers who scouted Azmoth Chasm were too terrified to explain much. Maybe Athena will be able to get some use of what little they managed to say.
QuestInfo.2: You conveyed what you learned from the scouting party to Athena.

0.msg: No... No... Not again... Never again...

1.msg: (You can barely make out what he's mumbling to himself. Maybe you'll learn something if you listen close.)
